items.title: Selection bar shows the Position cluster with protection notice
items.precondition: Map Editor as Administrator, Lots step (press V), ⌘A to select the active block
items.expected: Nudge pad, step cycler (0.05/0.25/1 m), rotate ±, Duplicate, and the banner counting protected lots ('never deleted, moved, or rotated')
items.evidence: Agent run 2026-07-31: 432 selected — full cluster rendered; banner reported 108 protected

items.title: Arrow keys nudge the selection in metre steps
steps: 2. Compare lots against their block outline
items.expected: Selection shifts 0.75 m east (Alt = 0.05 m, Shift = 1 m steps); protected lots stay put
items.evidence: Agent run 2026-07-31: visible eastward shift of B01 lots relative to the dotted outline

items.title: [ and ] rotate the selection in 0.5° steps
steps: 2. Undo restores the exact original geometry
items.expected: Selection rotates around its centre; undo returns it flush
items.evidence: Agent run 2026-07-31: rotation applied; two undos restored the layout flush to the outline

items.title: Nudge/rotate bursts coalesce into few undo entries
items.precondition: After a burst of arrow/rotate presses
steps: 2. Count the undos needed to restore
items.expected: A handful of presses in one gesture = one undo entry (900 ms window)
items.evidence: Agent run 2026-07-31: 7 keypresses reverted by 2 undo clicks

items.title: Duplicate stamps clones one pitch along the row, selected
steps: 2. Watch counts, selection, and the review state
items.expected: Clones appear beside the originals and become the selection; lot counts update; overlaps flagged if they collide; ONE undo removes all clones
items.evidence: Agent run 2026-07-31: 432 duplicated (904→1,336, B01 432→864, review flagged 819 overlap issues); single undo restored 904/ready

items.title: Draw → one-card create: tier prices, auto-fill count, estimated value, single undo
items.precondition: Blocks step, Block tool (press B), real mouse
steps: 1. Drag a rectangle on open ground
2. Open the tier select — each tier shows its current price
3. Read the auto-fill line (rows × cols ≈ N lots · est. ₱)
items.expected: Block and all its lots appear together; the estimate matches count × tier price; one undo removes block and lots together
items.notes: Drawing needs a real drag — the embedded QA pane cannot dispatch it. Store path (planGrid/buildLots inside one mutate) is the same machinery the passing duplicate/undo tests exercised.

items.title: Delete is visibly blocked for protected-only selections
items.precondition: Select only sold/occupied lots (click one with a real mouse, or Select by → status)
steps: 2. Look at Delete in the bar
items.expected: Delete is disabled with the explanation tooltip; mixed selections keep Delete enabled but only remove unprotected lots (existing store guard)
items.notes: Guard verified in code (isProtected covers sold/occupied/contract/interments; deleteLots filters); disabled state needs a protected-only selection to eyeball

items.title: Single-lot click select → nudge → duplicate flow feels right
steps: 3. Duplicate a few times along the row
items.expected: Fine positioning works lot-by-lot; duplicates chain along messy rows
items.notes: Click-select is pre-existing behavior the embedded pane could not drive; all the invoked actions are covered by T2–T5
